meaning:
κακόω, -ῶ
(κακός), [in LXX chiefly for רָעַע hi., עָנָה pi. ;]
1. to ill-treat, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), Act.7:6, 19 12:1 18:10, 1Pe.3:13.
2. (not in cl.), to embitter (Psa.106:32): Act.14:2,†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.
Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?
